notes.title: [Patch note: Ver. 230720] Improved game resolution!
notes.content: - With the release of the Nintendo Switch version, the resolution of the conversation scenes and the game's rendering resolution have been improved.

notes.title: [Patch note: Ver. 220911] Additional graphics options.
notes.content:
- Added dot-by-dot to display settings.
- Modified illustrations on the title screen.

notes.title: [Patchnote: Ver.220902] Fixed font size for Traditional Chinese
notes.content: - Fixed an issue where the font size is not displayed correctly when Traditional Chinese is selected in the language setting.
